name: RTX HDR Image Booster
description: Lists images, videos, and streams found on any page in a popup, and turns directly-opened images into live canvas-stream video so RTX Video HDR tone-maps them like real video. Unblocks RTX Video HDR on sites whose own videos are kept off Chrome's overlay path, with a one-key fix-and-fullscreen (Alt+Shift+F). Convert/revert any image, open local pictures/folders, and export Ultra HDR (.jpg) files.

action.default_title: RTX HDR Image Booster — view detected images
